acceptance: A1: The smoke workflow uses terminal ci-evidence with needs: [template-smoke, installation-smoke, release-evidence] and if: always(), and records all three real results including skipped.

A2: On an ordinary pull request without explicit release-preparation intent, release-evidence runs no release-state or release-distribution Contract check, records the path as not applicable, and succeeds.

A3: With explicit release-preparation intent, release-evidence runs release-state consistency and runs release-distribution when the controlled release paths changed; either failure remains release-blocking.

A4: Aggregate evidence validates before the Job returns failure and accurately reports all-success, upstream failure with dependent skips, and an individual downstream failure without inventing template-smoke:success as a failure reason.
A5: Validator diagnostics independently identify expected Head mismatch, workflow-run Head mismatch, required-job set mismatch, missing required Job, and Job/top-level conclusion inconsistency.
A6: Regression coverage reproduces run 30272658885 control flow and proves the unconditional ordinary-PR release-state command cannot recur.
A7: The plan and Summary record PR #410 as superseded and preserve RFE-ISSUE-106/RFE-ISSUE-107 for final process review; WI-21 remains blocked until replacement hosted CI succeeds.

A8: All required AI/project checks pass and the replacement Work Item completes archive, PR, hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and base synchronization without publishing a release.
guidelines: Preserve fail-closed behavior for explicit release preparation and verified or published evidence.

Add regression coverage for the hosted failure before applying the workflow correction.

intent.problem: PR #410 hosted run 30272658885 proved the terminal aggregate design but failed because release-evidence unconditionally ran check-release-state-consistency even though RELEASE_PREPARATION_INTENT was false. This violated the existing ordinary-PR boundary from RFE-ISSUE-082 and blocked a non-release PR after a 21m56s successful quality run.
constraints: Start from latest origin/main and preserve superseded evidence as immutable.
Keep all release Contract checks behind explicit release-preparation intent.
Keep all three Jobs required and observable in terminal aggregate evidence.
Keep WI-21, WI-10, and release publication out of scope.
Do not lower any quality, evidence, SBOM, provenance, or release threshold.
intent.rationale: Replace the superseded PR with one source-bound Work Item that retains the verified aggregate behavior and fixes the exact hosted ordinary-PR boundary before WI-21 is retried.
